cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. Wonderful, a walking lesson! I taught you to navigate without that phone; now you can show me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's pouring. I was hoping to stay dry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better: you'll finally use my lesson about finding shelter. Lead us from awning to awning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The next awning's gone, and my shoe's filling with water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant, you're reading conditions as well as the map. Take my arm; today you graduate to choosing a route for two people.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 failed car becomes navigation lesson; A3 rain becomes shelter practice; A5 missing shelter becomes route-for-two graduation, although two-person navigation was already the task.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rain causes A3 awnings; B4 missing awning and wet shoe causes A5 offered arm, but the proposed new graduation barely changes the route task.

relationship.evidence: B4 reports a real failure of A shelter plan and personal discomfort.
